cards.back:
The top number in a fraction.
Bahasa Indonesia: pembilang
Example: In the fraction three quarters, the numerator is three.
cards.say: numerator. The top number in a fraction. In the fraction three quarters, the numerator is three.

cards.back:
The bottom number in a fraction.
Bahasa Indonesia: penyebut
Example: In the fraction two fifths, the denominator is five.
cards.say: denominator. The bottom number in a fraction. In the fraction two fifths, the denominator is five.

cards.back:
Equal in value.
Bahasa Indonesia: setara
Example: One half is equivalent to two quarters of the same whole.
cards.say: equivalent. Equal in value. One half is equivalent to two quarters of the same whole.

cards.back:
The total distance around the edge of a shape.
Bahasa Indonesia: keliling
Example: The perimeter of a square with sides of two metres is eight metres.
cards.say: perimeter. The total distance around the edge of a shape. The perimeter of a square with sides of two metres is eight metres.

cards.back:
The amount of flat space inside a shape.
Bahasa Indonesia: luas
Example: We measured the area of the classroom floor in square metres.
cards.say: area. The amount of flat space inside a shape. We measured the area of the classroom floor in square metres.

cards.back:
The amount of space that a solid shape or liquid takes up.
Bahasa Indonesia: volume
Example: The volume of the jug is one litre.
cards.say: volume. The amount of space that a solid shape or liquid takes up. The volume of the jug is one litre.

cards.back:
The distance around a circle.
Bahasa Indonesia: keliling lingkaran
Example: We wrapped string around the tin to measure its circumference.
cards.say: circumference. The distance around a circle. We wrapped string around the tin to measure its circumference.

cards.back:
A straight line across a circle through its centre.
Bahasa Indonesia: diameter
Example: The diameter of the clock face is thirty centimetres.
cards.say: diameter. A straight line across a circle through its centre. The diameter of the clock face is thirty centimetres.

cards.back:
The distance from the centre of a circle to its edge.
Bahasa Indonesia: jari-jari
Example: The radius of the coin is half its diameter.
cards.say: radius. The distance from the centre of a circle to its edge. The radius of the coin is half its diameter.

cards.back:
Lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet.
Bahasa Indonesia: sejajar
Example: Railway tracks are parallel lines that run side by side.
cards.say: parallel. Lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet. Railway tracks are parallel lines that run side by side.

cards.back:
Meeting another line at a right angle.
Bahasa Indonesia: tegak lurus
Example: The wall stands perpendicular to the floor of the room.
cards.say: perpendicular. Meeting another line at a right angle. The wall stands perpendicular to the floor of the room.

cards.back:
When one half of a shape is a mirror image of the other half.
Bahasa Indonesia: simetri
Example: A butterfly's wings show nearly perfect symmetry when they open.
cards.say: symmetry. When one half of a shape is a mirror image of the other half. A butterfly's wings show nearly perfect symmetry when they open.

cards.back:
Add the numbers, then divide by how many there are. Also called the mean.
Bahasa Indonesia: rata-rata
Example: The average of two, four and six is four.
cards.say: average. Add the numbers, then divide by how many there are. Also called the mean. The average of two, four and six is four.

cards.back:
To make a careful guess about a number.
Bahasa Indonesia: memperkirakan, mengestimasi
Example: Estimate the answer first, then check it with a calculator.
cards.say: estimate. To make a careful guess about a number. Estimate the answer first, then check it with a calculator.

cards.back:
A number you get by multiplying by a whole number.
Bahasa Indonesia: kelipatan
Example: Twelve is a multiple of three and four.
cards.say: multiple. A number you get by multiplying by a whole number. Twelve is a multiple of three and four.

cards.back:
A number that divides exactly into another number.
Bahasa Indonesia: faktor
Example: Four is a factor of twelve because four times three is twelve.
cards.say: factor. A number that divides exactly into another number. Four is a factor of twelve because four times three is twelve.

cards.back:
A number that has exactly two factors, one and itself.
Bahasa Indonesia: bilangan prima
Example: Seven is a prime number because only one and seven divide into it exactly.
cards.say: prime number. A number that has exactly two factors, one and itself. Seven is a prime number because only one and seven divide into it exactly.

cards.back:
A number that is less than zero.
Bahasa Indonesia: bilangan negatif
Example: The temperature fell to minus five degrees overnight.
cards.say: negative number. A number that is less than zero. The temperature fell to minus five degrees overnight.

cards.back:
A comparison of two amounts.
Bahasa Indonesia: rasio
Example: The ratio of boys to girls in the club is two to three.
cards.say: ratio. A comparison of two amounts. The ratio of boys to girls in the club is two to three.

cards.back:
A number out of one hundred.
Bahasa Indonesia: persentase
Example: Half of the class means fifty percent.
cards.say: percentage. A number out of one hundred. Half of the class means fifty percent.

cards.back:
A number with a decimal point, which shows parts smaller than one.
Bahasa Indonesia: desimal
Example: A decimal such as zero point five means one half.
cards.say: decimal. A number with a decimal point, which shows parts smaller than one. A decimal such as zero point five means one half.

cards.back:
The amount of turn between two lines that meet at a point.
Bahasa Indonesia: sudut
Example: A right angle is exactly ninety degrees, like the corner of a book.
cards.say: angle. The amount of turn between two lines that meet at a point. A right angle is exactly ninety degrees, like the corner of a book.
